prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1409; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the sideswipe collision you were involved in while driving in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please tell me in your own words what happened.

A: I was changing lanes on the freeway, checking my mirror first. I signaled, and when I moved over, a vehicle in that lane came up alongside me and our passenger-side and driver-side mirrors clipped each other. I felt my car pull toward the shoulder, and I corrected it.

Q: Were you able to stop safely afterward?

A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder a short distance ahead. The other driver pulled over too.

Q: Did you notice how fast the other vehicle was traveling?

A: It was moving faster than I was, maybe somewhat faster than the posted limit, but I didn't check the speedometer. I was focused on getting my own car under control.

Q: Did either of you call for assistance?

A: Yes, someone called the police, and an officer came out and filled out a report.

Q: Did you receive any injuries?

A: Yes. I put my right hand out to brace myself when the car jerked, and I landed hard on my wrist. The doctor later told me it was fractured. I have a cast now and I've had to take time away from work.

Q: Have you received medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I was seen at an urgent care clinic that day and have followed up with a specialist since.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add?

A: No, I think that covers it. I am willing to provide the police report and my medical records.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
